```{r Load packages}

require(hausekeep)
require(tidyverse)
require(lme4)
require(lmerTest)


```



```{r}

# Empathy opportunity models
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ SITES_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .154
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ EST_score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .020
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ Mall_of_E_Score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .022
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ EI_DC_score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .050
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ EI_PNC_score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .671
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ IRI_EC_score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .468
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ IRI_PT_score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .006
summary(glmer(E_Opp ~ IRI_F_score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .0003, .0027 
summaryh(glmer(E_Opp ~ IRI_PD_score_C + (1|User_Id), data = df, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# .479, .539

EOPP_Ps <- p.adjust(c(.154, .020, .022, .050, .671, .468, .006, .0003, .479), method = "fdr")
```
